messages:
marie: Urgent — MediCore POC (Android) demo fails: SSE stream yields JSON.parse errors then disconnects after ~12s. Can eng advise? cc @sara @jordan

sara: Is there a customer gateway in front? Paste client log + raw SSE bytes.

marie: Yes, Apigee in path. Client log:
```
E/SSE: JSON.parse Unexpected end of input
E/SSE: last_chunk='\{"note\":\"Follow-up on med'
```
Raw SSE concat:
```
data: {"type":"note","payload":{"id":7,"note":"Follow-up on med\n\n
data: s and dosing"}}

```
jordan: Classic split across chunk/boundary. Likely gateway buffering or idle timeout. Check gateway logs for idle timeout and whether streaming mode is enabled.

sara: Short fixes: 1) emit SSE comment heartbeat every 7s (`: hb\n\n`) to beat idle timeouts, 2) ensure `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, and disable gzip for route, 3) flush after each event on server. If gateway timeout is 15s, heartbeat must be <15s.

marie: Gateway log shows idle timeout=20s. We'll ask them to enable streaming and turn off response buffering. Can Redwood inject keepalives for hosted POCs?

jordan: Not right now by default; we can patch demo server to emit heartbeats for this POC quickly. Longer term feature request possible.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: POC-7890 escalated to eng-oncall tag: sse-streaming

marie: I'm on the call with them now to change gateway flags and push a heartbeat patch. Will update after fixes. :thumbsup:
